title: Rc Math Smoke
objective: Create a fast authoritative release mathematics smoke corpus spanning ZZ, QQ, GF(p), GF(2), polynomials, extensions, graphs, and modular symbols.

oracles: algebraic reconstruction, inverse, kernel, and serialization invariants

handoff.summary: Added one deterministic, unchanged Sage mathematics program and a release verifier that runs it through source-checkout, installed-package, or standalone-executable entry points from a clean temporary directory. The corpus verifies exact outputs and reconstruction invariants across ZZ, QQ, GF(97), and GF(2) matrices; exact, finite-field, and extension-field polynomials; GF(9); Petersen graph invariants and graph6; modular symbols and Hecke operators; mutation isolation; SagePack round trips; and deterministic lazy-native execution. Structured reports identify the artifact, runtime budget, every completed section, and all traced implementation selections; --require-native fails closed when only fallback execution is observed. Warm linux-x64 source and package runs complete in roughly 1.3 to 2.0 seconds, well below the 30-second release budget.
risks: The tracked test requires one shared registration in test/node-test-manifest.cjs. That file is intentionally outside this lane's claims; integration will add the entry and rerun pnpm test:portable.

A stale pre-lane SEA at /home/user/sagejs/build/sea/sagejs failed the unchanged corpus at exact ZZ polynomial gcd. This is useful release-drift detection, not a reason to weaken the corpus; newly built artifacts must pass it.
This lane's recorded execution evidence is linux-x64. The same verifier must be run against Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64, and Windows x64 artifacts by their release lanes.
next_steps: Register test/release-math-smoke.cjs in the shared test/node-test-manifest.cjs and rerun pnpm test:portable after integration.
Run scripts/release-math-smoke.cjs --require-native against each clean npm installation and every newly built standalone artifact.
Archive each JSON report beside the corresponding release manifest so release review retains exact mathematics and native-selection evidence.
